senses.sense_definition: a small wave or series of waves on the surface of water, caused by a slight breeze or an object dropping into it

examples.text: I dropped a small stone into the pond and watched the <w>ripples</w> spread across the calm surface.

target_lang_translations.ru: Я бросил маленький камень в пруд и наблюдал, как <w>круги</w> расходятся по спокойной поверхности.

senses.sense_definition: to spread through something or a group of people like a wave
